Context: 4. Pensioners/ Family Pensioners

the facilities for life-  
- (i) to a Government servant who pays at the time of his retirement lumpsum equal to 10 years contribution, in advance;
- (ii) to a Pensioner-beneficiary, who pays in lump balance contri bution for the remaining period out of 10 years; and
- (iii)
- to a Pensioner who had already subscribed for 10 years and over after retirement.  
Pensioners while on re-employment shall pay normal contribution like other serving employees. - OM, dated 29-8-1995.
